records.failureSummary:
Implemented the T-07 cell transformation pipeline in src/render.mjs (working tree). Added an internal helper transformCell(value) that coerces the value to a string (null/undefined become empty string), replaces every newline ( , or ) with
, escapes every | as \|, then trims leading and trailing whitespace, in that mandatory order. It is used for the header row (headers.map(transformCell)) and every data row (rows.map(row => row.map(transformCell))); separator entries are generated by separatorFor(align) and are never transformed. renderTable keeps its API (renderTable(table, options)), trust-boundary input validation (throws TypeError for a non-object table), width = max(3, longest transformed cell including header), right space padding on all columns including the last, and joining. src/parse.mjs is unmodified. npm run build exit 0 and npm run lint exit 0. npm run test: 18 tests, 17 pass, 1 fail. The single failure is test/render.cells.test.mjs item 11 ([AC-03] applies the combined transform to header and data cells alike), which is self-contradictory and cannot pass for any spec-conforming implementation: it feeds pipe-containing cells to that file's own cellsOf helper, which does line.slice(1,-1).split("|") and therefore splits on the escaped pipe's literal | character, yielding ["a\","b
c","h2"] instead of the expected ["a\|b
c","h2"]. The same file's header comment states cellsOf is only safe for values with no pipes and that singleCell must be used for pipe values, and items 5, 6, 7 and 10 already pin pipe escaping to backslash-pipe. Fixing that assertion is a test-side change outside the backend-only write scope, so I did not contort the spec-mandated escaping and did not modify any test file. The acceptance criterion AC-03 clause "Tests from T-01 pass" is therefore unattainable in this slice.
